scope: Git blob bytes of application, assets, migrations, tests, QA scripts and lockfiles; excludes documentation, ignored runtime/build/output and other school.
hash_method: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines: file_sha256 + two spaces + repository_path + LF, in listed order; per-file hash uses committed Git bytes.
changes_explanation: Only browser timing test synchronization/evidence changed, then the complete browser-round-two suite reran. No application/tested PHP/JS production behavior changed.
